properties.name: A design can say what it is for
properties.rationale:
Builds `dec:the-ility-target-is-a-governing-decision-asked-at-genesis`, which Anthony settled 2026-08-25 against three rejected homes.

WHY A PROPERTY AND NOT A REUSE. `DimensionAssessment` records a SCORE on an axis — what a system IS. This records what it is FOR. Overloading the first with the second is what made `Interface.designation` ambiguous, where an unclassified boundary and a deliberately internal one became indistinguishable. Measured the same day: 0 DimensionAssessment and 0 DimensionObservation nodes exist, so the nine-axis vocabulary had been fully defined and never once used — the vocabulary was never the missing piece.

⭐⭐ THREE STATES, AND THE THIRD CAME FROM THE USER MID-BUILD. Anthony, after the detector was already written: "a user may not know at genesis, so should be able to defer (becomes a gap until the user determines??)". The first half was already true — the gap fires until an accepted target exists — but the second half exposed a real flaw: a design that WEIGHED the question and a design nobody ASKED were reported identically. That is the failure `Decision.no_relation_note` exists to prevent on this same node type, and the fix is the same shape: a proposed target now reads "still being weighed" at severity 0.40 rather than "unstated" at 0.55.

🛑 AND THE OBVIOUS WAY TO DEFER WOULD HAVE BEEN THE WORST ONE. `acknowledge_gap` on an aggregate finding silences it permanently and for every capability added afterwards — the trap measured hours earlier on `unreviewed_ideas` and held open at `dec:idea-an-aggregate-acknowledgement-never-expires`. A deferral closed that way never comes back, which is the opposite of deferring. The finding text, the genesis skill and the repair row all say so, and a test pins it.

NO MIGRATION, DELIBERATELY. The property is optional with no default: absence must read as "nobody was asked" for the detector to work, and a default would be materialised onto every existing Decision when an export is read back — the failure `Capability.delivery` records, where a design whose export does not restore to itself is a backup that would not restore. Old graphs simply carry none.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT SETTLE: whether the allocation step needs a skill. It builds the FIRST STEP of one and leaves the method open, because only maintainability is runnable today, performance needs coupling data almost no design declares, and reliability and security have no substrate at all.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Added `Decision.quality_target` (nine axes, no default), the `set_quality_target` tool, and the `quality_target_unstated` gap with three states. Genesis asks the question; detect-and-ask carries the repair row; all three skill mirrors updated. Eight tests in tests/a_design_says_what_it_is_for.rs. One new toolsnap golden, nothing else on the surface moved.
